newsitem.title: USA: Witco sees Q3 below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Witco sees Q3 below expectations.

text.p: Witco Corp said on Friday that its third quarter net income could be as much as 30 percent below analysts' expectations which are as low as $0.30 a share.
In last year's third quarter, the company reported earnings of $19.4 million, or $0.34 a share, on sales of $441.9 million.
In response to the third quarter forecast, Witco said it has set a 60-day effort to form a plan to consolidate assets to cut costs and improve productivity at the company.

Witco plans to cut fixed costs by a minimum of 20 percent, variable costs by five percent to ten percent, and achieve an internal rate of return of at least 30 percent on new capital deployed under the plan.
The company said it aims to meet 50 percent of the goals in the first year and 90 percent in the second year with the plan completed within three years.
Witco chief financial officer Camillo DiFrancesco said the cost cutting probably will involve job cuts, but it is too soon to say where and how many cuts would be made.

The company said this kind of consolidation will be "difficult" for the company, but it will be done to "ensure that all employees will be treated with respect and maximum concern for their well being."
